technique_name: Describe the political situation and geography of Taiwan.
description: Taiwan is an island nation in East Asia located off the southeastern coast of mainland China and directly west of Japan and the East China sea. Taiwan is self-governed and has its own government, currency, and policies, although it is not currently recognized as an independent nation by the international community.
